A quick tour of what FlowFolio can do. Nothing here is required reading.
Bring in a PDF or EPUB with the + button. Your books live on shelves you make, and everything you mark while reading gathers in the tabs below.
Set the page and the sound together. Pick a mood in Settings and every book opens that way, with rain, a fire or a quiet caf\u00e9 behind the words.
Give yourself a time to read each day, week or month. The path in the library header fills as you get there, and you can be reminded on the days you choose.
A PDF can be read two ways: as printed, or reflowed to your screen and your font. Switch in the reader\'s Aa sheet, or hold a book in the library.
Select a word while reading to define or translate it, on the phone and offline. Every word you look up is kept, and tapping one takes you back to where you found it.
Say why a book is waiting
Tag a book with what it is actually waiting for -- the right mood, a study session, or someone to read it with -- so a pause never looks like abandonment.
Say what you think instead of typing it. Hold the microphone on an annotation to record, and the note is kept with the page it belongs to.
Hold the book on the riffle bar to mark where you are. Slide off anywhere you like; the mark pulses beside the page number until you tap it to come back.
%1$d folders came in with these %2$d books. FlowFolio can make a shelf for each one and stand its books on it, folders inside folders included.
Each shelf takes its folder\u2019s name and a colour picked at random. You can rename a shelf or change its colour whenever you like, and the books stay in your library either way.
Bring in PDFs and EPUBs with the + button \u2014 one file, several, or a whole folder. Every book shows how far you have got, and the shelf below holds the rest.
Pages curl as you turn them, two at a time on an unfolded screen. Tap the middle for the controls, the sides to turn, and pinch to change the type size.
Drag along the riffle strip to flick through the pages, with the chapters and your ribbons marked along the way. Hold the page numbers to drop a detour mark you can come straight back to.
A PDF whose text is too small to read reflows to fit your screen, prepared on your phone. The original stays exactly as it is, and the \u201cAa\u201d menu switches between the two.
Hold a passage to highlight it in any of nine colours, add a note, share it or copy it. Everything you mark is gathered in your Notebook, book by book.
Say what you were thinking instead of typing it. Hold a passage, tap the microphone, and the recording stays with those words, ready to play back later.
Look a word up in the dictionary on your phone \u2014 no connection needed \u2014 or translate a passage. Both remember where you asked, so a tap takes you back to the page.
Narrator Mode reads any book aloud with natural offline voices, turning the pages as it goes. Pick a voice and a speed once, and it remembers.
Set the page and the sound together: rain, a fire, a quiet caf\u00e9, a file of your own or any stream address. Pick a mood once and every book opens that way.
Set a goal for a day, a week or a month, pick the days that count and when to be reminded. The ring fills as you read, and finishing it is worth seeing.
Four themes including a true black one, seven reading fonts or the book\u2019s own, page colours, margins, page-turn styles and sounds. Settings has all of it.
